name: EXM_MEALS_POLICIES
description: This table contains details of all meals policies.

columns.name: MEALS_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Meals policy identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POLICY_NAME
columns.description: Name of this expense policy of meals category.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for this expense policy of meals category.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Meals policy status, such as Draft and Active. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: RATES_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the policy is created based on rates entered by the user or from rates uploaded from a Conus or OConus file.

columns.name: RATE_INCLUDE_MEALS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the meals allowance defined for the policy includes meals.

columns.name: RATE_INCLUDE_OTHER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the meals reimbursement defined for the policy includes other expenses.

columns.name: MEALS_RATE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Rates that are based on local rates or proportional rates.

columns.name: SINGLE_INSTANCE_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether meals expense policy limits are enforced by each submitted instance of meals expense item.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether daily amount limit of meals expenses is enforced. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: CURRENCY_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Currency option selected for the rate definition, such as single or multiple currency. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_CURRENCY_OPTION.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the expense policy when rates are defined in a single currency.

columns.name: ENABLED_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether meals rates vary based on the role of an employee.

columns.name: POLICY_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role type that determines the policy rate, such as Job, Grade, and Position. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_ROLE.

columns.name: ENABLED_LOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether meals rates vary by location.

columns.name: LOCATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of location that determines rates, such as Geographical Location and Zone. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_LOCATION_TYPE.

columns.name: ZONE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the applicable zone types for this policy. Values are from the lookup EXM_ZONE_TYPE.

columns.name: POLICY_ENFORCEMENT_CODE
columns.description: Type of meals expense policy enforcement applied. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_ENFORCEMENT.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether employees are warned when they submit expenses that exceed defined meals expense policy rate limit.

columns.name: WARNING_TOLERANCE
columns.description: Percentage that, when added to meals expense policy amount limit, defines maximum allowable limit, resulting in policy warning violation.

columns.name: DISP_WARNING_TO_USER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether meals expense policy warning is displayed to user.

columns.name: PREVENT_SUBMISSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether expense report submission is prevented if meals expense policy violation occurs.

columns.name: ERROR_TOLERANCE
columns.description: Percentage that, when added to meals expense policy amount limit, defines maximum allowable limit, resulting in prevention of expense report submission.
